hero.why: Codi rHB 2: the hero slide Image alone passes quality={88}; the custom loader sends q=88 to the Sanity CDN and picks the q88 variant set for the static fallback. Dots, slide labels and the autoplay modulus already read slides.length (BASE lines 71, 88, 179-183), so 3 slides need no edit there; f1-rendered R4 proves it.

lineEdits.to: // orchid-yellow returns to the rotation when a high-quality original arrives; the current file bands under the scrim (rHB).

fallback.why: Codi rHB 1: yellow leaves the static fallback, the comment says it returns with a high-quality original; public/images/orchid-yellow.jpg stays (other pages use it). Violet, pink, dark keep their order.

loader.why: Codi rHB 2 (variants): the same three source files feed ten other pages (NavCards, PageHeader images, NOS hero photos, ticket cards) through the same variant names, so re-encoding them in place at q88 would move every other image off 75. The hero's quality prop instead selects a separate -q88 set; every request without a quality prop maps to the BASE name, byte-identical.

variants.why: Codi rHB 2 (variants): hero fallback variants are webp q88 with sharp smartSubsample: true, as an extra -q88 set beside the unchanged q75 set; every other variant stays q75 and byte-identical. No 2560 hero variant is added (optional in the ruling; widths stay capped at 2048 by lib/image-widths.json).

css.why: Codi rHB 3. Veil >=768: Codi's exact stops. Veil <768: Codi's desktop tail mapped proportionally onto the mobile shoulder (70%, 0.86): position = 70 + 30 x (p - 62) / 38, alpha = 0.86 x a / 0.84, positions rounded to whole percent, alphas to 2 decimals (74 -> 79.47 -> 79%, 0.62 -> 0.635 -> 0.63; 86 -> 88.95 -> 89%, 0.34 -> 0.348 -> 0.35; 94 -> 95.26 -> 95%, 0.12 -> 0.123 -> 0.12). Pull: Codi's stops, but on --parchment (#f4f3ec = rgb 244 243 236), not --bone: MissionBlock's section is bg-parchment (components/home/MissionBlock.tsx:42), so a bone pull ends 12-16 levels off the next section (the seam). The diagonal is unchanged; no dither or noise layer.
